notes.title: Features Updates
notes.content:
Added a Save System
 Added Local Co-op
 Better movement controls
 Some level layout changes

notes.title: Gameplay Update : Map Added
notes.content: Player can now see their position on a map which can be accessed by collecting powerup.

notes.title: Gameplay Updates
notes.content:
Pause Menu - Player can access menu for sound controls
 Wall Slide - more intuitive
 Holding jump while sliding grabs the wall
 Door Button Updated - more intuitive
 Stamina Meter Updated - stamina orbs
 Perfect Jump Added - updated
 View Map Updated - updated
 Few Level Design Updates - should make navigation more easy
